latestVersion.changelog: Security Joes AI Analyst 1.0.0 – Initial Release - Provides an AI-driven SecOps checklist for Windows endpoints, focusing on EDR, Sysmon, system updates, event log (EVTX) monitoring, least privilege enforcement, network visibility, and credential protection. - Supports weekly automated security posture assessments and reporting, including vulnerability inventory and alerts on known CVEs. - Implements skill integrity checking via hash verification to detect unexpected changes or potential skill compromise. - Designed for use in endpoint health reviews, collector/heartbeat logic, credential hardening, and healthy endpoint dashboard reviews.
